recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-28453 unless a future work-group decision changes the broader CanonicalResource copyright model.
issue_request: FHIR-28453 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request asking that OperationDefinition have a copyright element like StructureDefinition and other CanonicalResource-derived artifacts, with resolution text stating it would be added as defined in CanonicalResource.
initial_application: Git commit b2e9e2a04fe35a343723dc221228a4c5f8679fa3 explicitly applied FHIR-28453 by adding OperationDefinition.copyright to source/operationdefinition/structuredefinition-OperationDefinition.xml as a 0..1 markdown element mapped to Definition.copyright. No earlier application was found before that Jira-tagged commit.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2021-01-04 record the rationale and 16-0-0 vote: because the CanonicalResource pattern does not guarantee its elements show in child resources, copyright should be added to OperationDefinition to emphasize the element's presence. The current source keeps OperationDefinition active in source/fhir.ini, declares the CanonicalResource template/baseDefinition, and includes OperationDefinition.copyright. Later copyright-family work, including FHIR-20513 and FHIR-49012, added copyrightLabel and refined wording without reversing the requested element.
reconciliation: No source edit was needed. The current active OperationDefinition definition already has OperationDefinition.copyright with cardinality 0..1, type markdown, Definition.copyright mapping, and CanonicalResource-aligned copyright semantics.

related_jiras.note: Added copyrightLabel to FHIR-I canonical resources, including OperationDefinition, and clarified how short copyright declarations relate to the broader copyright element. It did not remove or conflict with OperationDefinition.copyright.
Later refined the copyright and copyrightLabel definitions across canonical resources, including the current OperationDefinition wording, without reversing FHIR-28453.
